items.name: Shieldfriend's Band
items.lore: The Mag Mell Guard give this band to those who have stood a watch beside them.

items.name: Mag Mell Watch Belt
items.lore: Worn by the town watch, and by the few outsiders they would trust with a gate.

items.name: Sword-Oath Torc
items.lore: Bronze, twisted thrice: one turn for the town, one for the lake, one for the oath.

items.name: Lake Road Bracer
items.lore: Scuffed from years of riding the lake road between Mag Mell and the shore forts.

items.name: Mantle of the Red Hand Breaker
items.lore: Lake-blue, with a red hand torn across. The Guard make one for each who earns the name.

items.name: Rowan-Berry Charm
items.lore: Rowan berries on red thread, against the Good People's mischief. It works, mostly.

items.name: Wise-Woman's Bracer
items.lore: Brid wove it from willow and her own grey hair. Don't ask what the knots mean.

items.name: Gift of the Good People
items.lore: A ring found on your pillow one morning, still cold with dew. Say thank you to no one.

items.name: Hazel-Wand Belt
items.lore: Hazel for wisdom, bound in leather by someone who has walked the fairy roads.

items.name: Mantle of the Lucht Feasa
items.lore: Grey as mist on the mere. The Good People step aside for whoever wears it.
